message: 生理的に受け付けない

name: Eddie
message: 「When a pot gets scorched, soaking it overnight in the water from washing rice is supposed to do the trick.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, class is about to start, and Azel...」

name: Synn
message: 「Actually, he left during class and still hasn't come back」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Skipping out on his duties yet again!?」

name: Synn
message: 「No. I thought he went to the bathroom, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, when he stepped out, he really didn't look like he was feeling well」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've got it! Azel must have been caught by Hanazawa-san of the toilet!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There's no time to lose! We must go save them right away!」

name: Synn
message: 「Not in the infirmary either. Where on earth could they have gone」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you figure out where they are?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-no! Even an omniscient and omnipotent being like me doesn't know that much」

name: Synn
message: 「So it wasn't the restroom... Then maybe they collapsed somewhere...」

name: Synn
message: 「If that's the case, this is bad. We have to hurry and look!」
Someone is curled up on the long bench.

name: Synn
message: 「Do you have some idea what illness it might be!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh!? W-Well, that is... um, you see... uhh, well...」

name: Synn
message: 「What should we do? Maybe we really should take them to the hospital...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hwah!! I-If you did that... it would be a disaster!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nothing, I was just talking to myself!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah! Got it! You see, Azel―san's illness is―」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's fine, just leave this to me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, if that's the case, there must be some way to deal with it...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「U-Um... I have yet to experience menstruation myself...」
Lolotte's a late bloomer--no, no, stop thinking about that!

name: Synn
message: 「This is tough... Anyway, I have to ask someone for help」
Ugh, this is so embarrassing! Still, it's for Azel's sake. It's my duty as Student Council President!!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer! What should one do when on their period!?」
Ahh, give me back my courage.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Stop putting weird ideas into Loro-chan's head!!」

name: Synn
message: 「What would I even gain from doing that!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sorry... It's all because I'm so hopeless...」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, it's not your fault, Lolotte. People all develop at slightly different paces, after all...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, she ain't human in the first place」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Panda!! Don't just pop out when it's convenient for you--come out when it actually matters!」

name: Paqy
message: 「My bad. It's just that I really can't handle that Azel woman...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Azel is... um... suffering right now. Right, Lolotte?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't just blurt it out like that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Got it, got it. So, where is she?」

name: Synn
message: 「I think she's lying down in the church.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Are you not coming with us, President?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It'd be embarrassing if a guy tagged along. Even for Azel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Are periods something to be embarrassed about?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is it really such an embarrassing illness!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Punting that question to a shy, delicate flower like me is totally unfair~」

name: Synn
message: 「Guys don't get them, so I wouldn't know!\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oho~~. So it is an illness that men do not contract.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait a second, Roro-chan. Have you not gotten your period yet?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Period coming...? Yes, well, nobody by that name has come here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Wait, does that mean... could it be...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You look so innocent, what a shocker~! Even I'm blown away~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who was it with... d-d-don't tell me!?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no!! It's nothing like that, she just hasn't experienced her period yet」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then why the hell do you know about that!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't talk about weird stuff like that!!」
Talk about adding insult to injury.

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, having to deal with that every single month」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord. Are you seriously saying that?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm dead serious! That's why we've gotta take good care of girls」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sigh... that's not it. Just so you know, Aze--」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. That's a relief. Nanaka and the others explained everything to you properly, right?」
She really is a mysterious girl.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It seems it was just a misunderstanding on my part. My sincerest apologies.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no! As long as she's fine, that's all that matters」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wasn't someone around here having some naughty fantasies?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh--?! I wasn't doing anything like that!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Temporary symptoms... Azel-san, after all... isn't able to adapt, is he...?」
